title: Cruisin' Tikis Nashville

services.name: Public Downtown Tiki Cruise
services.desc: Experience the best of Nashville with our 90-minute private cruises, available all day, every day! Escape the heat and take a break from Broadway to create unforgettable memories on the water … TIKI style

gap: Duration not stated for some cruises
blurb: Guests board a floating tiki bar boat for public or private cruises on Nashville waterways. Cruises include downtown riverfront tours, sunset cruises, and private party cove excursions. Guests bring their own beverages and snacks, and enjoy a fun, tropical atmosphere with views of the city and opportunities to swim on some tours.
extraNote: Starting dock 15 minutes before scheduled departure; Nashville location at 525 Basswood Drive, Nashville, TN 37209 or Old Hickory Lake at 727 Marina Rd, Gallatin, TN 37066
